rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 6 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010): a real constraint the prototype cannot express (persistence, cross-service behaviour) overrides the prototype default; Design Release 2.1 has no amending state at all, and its catch-all status mapping would file an amendment as a draft only by fallback, while the backend persists an amendment as a submitted notification in AMEND that never returns to DRAFT and publishes it to other services as an amendment of a submission.
outcome: A notification being amended is listed in the 'In progress' tab with today's yellow 'Amending' tag and its status-driven actions (Resume, Copy as new, Cancel amendment, Delete). The tabs otherwise follow Design Release 2.1 ('In progress' for submitted and action-required, 'Draft' for drafts, 'Completed' for completed). The prototype's fallback mapping of unknown statuses to the draft variant is set aside for amendments only, because an amendment is a persisted, already-submitted notification under change (status AMEND, which nothing moves back to DRAFT, re-submitted as NotificationSubmissionAmended and deleted as a submission), a lifecycle and cross-service constraint the prototype cannot express.
